name: api-authz
description: An authorization sweep over an API with two supplied identities: object-level, function-level and tenancy. Needs two credentials; without them the workflow refuses rather than guessing, because one account cannot demonstrate this class.

tasks.title: Enumerate the API surface of {{target}} as {{actor_a}}
tasks.goal: List every endpoint, method and identifier-bearing parameter on {{target}}: query parameters, path segments, JSON body fields, headers and cookies that look like primary keys. Record each as surface. Note which endpoints change state.
done_when: every identifier-bearing input is in the ledger
state-changing endpoints are marked as such

tasks.title: Establish what each identity is entitled to
tasks.goal: For {{actor_a}} and {{actor_b}}, record their own object ids and what a legitimate read returns. Record an unauthenticated request and a request for an id that cannot exist. These four shapes are the controls every later claim depends on.
done_when: a control record exists for: own read, unauthenticated read, nonexistent id

tasks.title: Cross-read: {{actor_a}} against {{actor_b}}'s objects
tasks.goal: For each identifier-bearing input, have {{actor_a}} request {{actor_b}}'s object. Every record names the actor AND the accessed_subject, and the body span must contain what identifies the owner. A 200 alone is not evidence of whose data it was.
done_when: each input is either a proven cross-read or falsified with an observation
every claim has its entitlement control on record

tasks.title: Function-level: can {{actor_a}} perform {{actor_b}}'s privileged action
tasks.goal: For each state-changing endpoint, read the state, act as {{actor_a}} on {{actor_b}}'s object, then read it again. The after-read is what proves it. Record the three phases with phase=before, action, after and name the owner.
done_when: each privileged action is proven with three phases or falsified
anything changed is recorded and reverted

tasks.title: Review every authorization claim
tasks.goal: For each finding, check that the evidence names two identities, that the control is present, and that the claim is not broader than the records support.
done_when: every confirmed finding carries a cross-verification record

tasks.title: Write the authorization report
tasks.goal: Report per endpoint, not per payload. Say which endpoints were tested with two identities, which were tested with one and therefore not demonstrated, and which were not reached at all.
